proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport IPC registration: it now registers/maps full multi-segment physical allocations, batches FD conversion, tracks per-connection imported handles, and hardens proxy-side deregistration/cleanup. Memory is also required because allocation/free and registration-lifecycle paths were substantively changed to carry segment counts, free multi-segment mappings safely, and drain callbacks before local deregistration to prevent stale mapping reuse.
